candidates.name: Index polygons spatial data (INSPIRE)
verified_facts: INSPIRE Index Polygons are an open-source subset covering freehold registered property in England and Wales.
Each polygon has a Land Registry-INSPIRE ID related to a registered title, but a single title can contain several polygons.
HM Land Registry states the extent of land in a registered title cannot be established from INSPIRE Index Polygons and must be identified from the individual title plan.
The dataset is updated on the first Sunday of each month, shows data from the previous month, and is distributed as GML under OGL conditions.
semantic_limits: INSPIRE geometry is an indicative freehold indexing product; absence can also reflect leasehold or other excluded tenure and cannot be treated as proof of no registered title, exact legal extent or parcel elevation.

candidates.name: National Polygon dataset - Technical specification
verified_facts: The National Polygon Dataset is the published HM Land Registry Index Polygon dataset for England and Wales.
The title plan and register record general boundary position unless a boundary has been determined as exact; index polygons provide an indicative title location.
Each index polygon has a Poly_ID linked to a title number and carries INSERT, UPDATE, version and record-status fields for lifecycle tracking.
The technical specification states the NPD is updated monthly.
semantic_limits: The technical specification is used only for schema and lifecycle semantics; no paid NPD records were acquired, and index polygons are not promoted to exact legal-boundary or elevation evidence.
